Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28777 (#28746), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the review checklist requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat: p3 (documentation of a rule the gate now enforces; nothing the pages teach is falsified, they are silent on the locale), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).
Reach: an AI author or developer customizing a vendor email template through a `<base>.custom` pair, who learns from the skill or the docs that a same-name item with `overrides` replaces the base item, and so declares `overrides` on a locale the base never shipped. After PR #28777 that write is refused (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`).

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, the ADR-0146 customization paragraph (it lists `email_template` among the honoured types): one sentence that an email template is one item per (name, locale), so an override names a locale the base ships, and a locale the base does not ship is added without `overrides`.
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, the ADR-0146 section (≈ line 117, "bears a base item's name"): the same rule for `email_template`: the name **and** a locale the base ships.
- Lands after PR #28777 merges. `skills/**` is a governed path (Tier H) and publishes via `@objectstack/skills`.
